scope: All tracked and untracked local audio, arena, camera, layout, documentation and test changes against HEAD. User conversation supplies the specification.
deployment: Local changes only; no production deployment performed.
result: No remaining confirmed introduced defects within the reviewed scope after fixes and independent follow-up.

maintainability.finding: Three music-pause writers duplicated different subsets of the same policy.
maintainability.classification: Duplicated Code / Shotgun Surgery heuristic, not a documented standards violation.
maintainability.resolution: Game.tsx now shares isGameQuiet and syncAmbiencePause across animation, React effects and visibility handling.

correctnessFindings.finding: Scenery cover depended on the camera rectangle, moving the background against fixed platforms during wider recovery pans.
correctnessFindings.reproduction: At 1440x800, use players (-140,100) and (520,554), then translate both x positions by 160. Same zoom but different world cover x before the fix.
correctnessFindings.resolution: Use a fixed world cover for scenery and environment animation, with mirrored world-anchored tiles covering overflow.
correctnessFindings.followUp: Reviewer independently confirmed the fix, passed ten camera/viewport tests and exact tile-boundary checks from -3 through +3.

correctnessFindings.requirement: Maximum voluntary separation 660, while preserving character abilities.
correctnessFindings.finding: A rooted fighter's approach velocity was counted before being canceled, granting extra retreat space to the rival.
correctnessFindings.reproduction: At x210 and x870, root player 0 and hold right for both. Separation previously increased to 661.855 on the first tick.
correctnessFindings.resolution: Enforce grounded roots before predicting movement for both players.
regressions: twenty retreat frames at the boundary

correctnessFindings.requirement: Limit voluntary separation while preserving forced movement and ringouts.
correctnessFindings.finding: Blocked projectile recoil has no hit stun, so the retreat limiter canceled it at separation 660. This prevented a ledge ringout that occurred at separation 600.
correctnessFindings.resolution: Track the contact-induced portion of horizontal velocity as serialized recoilVx, preserve it through the spacing calculation and update it with acceleration, braking, special movement, roots, pulls and respawn.

spec.followUp: Reviewer inspected final root, recoil, scenery and shared music-pause fixes. Twenty targeted tests and 72 temporary recoil cases passed, including mirrored positions, grounded/airborne movement, simultaneous retreat, final stun transitions and JSON serialization.

verification.build: npm run build passed; existing bundle-size warning remains.

browser.environment: Local development server on port 5184, product-native collaborative browser
checks: actual stage images and Canvas renderer
fixed world artwork transform across wide pans and zoom
opaque viewport corners in every view

network.environment: Restarted local development server with final shared engine changes

limits: Physical mobile hardware and subjective audio listening quality are not established by these automated checks.
The final WebSocket smoke check does not establish real-browser network interpolation under variable latency.
Deep downward recovery can remain partly outside the camera; comparable clipping predates these changes and is not classified as an introduced defect.
Character bout fixtures explicitly open with a special, so they do not prove autonomous special selection; dedicated ability tests remain in place.
Extreme recovery overflow mirrors scenery artwork; it can visibly repeat beyond the original world image.
